meta.title: Soft tissue sarcoma in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Adult soft tissue sarcoma (extremity/trunk/retroperitoneal; non-GIST, non-bone), ~70 histologic subtypes
meta.population: Adults with soft tissue sarcoma - SEVENTY DISEASES IN A TRENCH COAT: ~70 WHO subtypes (textbook-grade) sharing a referral pathway and little else, where HISTOLOGY ROUTES EVERYTHING and the first artifact is expert pathology review - because the discordance receipts are verified and worse than commonly taught (25% major discrepancy in one matched series; a prospective regional series modified >40% of diagnoses with 19% complete discordance - the briefing's '10-25%' was the FLOOR, corrected). The trainer covers the rest-of-STS after its neighbors: uterine LMS (the LIVE uterine-sarcoma trainer - the registry's twelfth live reroute), GIST and bone sarcomas (their own queued rows, blocked honestly). The organizing story is the era shift: the HISTOLOGY-AGNOSTIC era (limb-sparing, SMAC, doxorubicin-for-everyone) giving way to the HISTOLOGY-DIRECTED era (trabectedin-myxoid, imatinib-DFSP, atezolizumab-ASPS, cell therapy for synovial, nirogacestat-desmoid) - with ISG-STS 1001 as the humbling pivot: prospective histology-TAILORING of chemotherapy failed when tried.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for seventy diseases in a trench coat. THE ERA-SHIFT SPINE: the histology-agnostic receipts verified end-to-end - Rosenberg's 43-patient limb-sparing principle-setter (verified, with its 1992 decoy documented - taught as principle, never effect size), O'Sullivan's pre-vs-postop trade (verified for the wound-complication half; the late-fibrosis half is the Davis follow-up, honestly flagged), SMAC (verified: 1,568 patients - RFS yes, OS trend only; its near-identically-titled Cochrane twin documented), EORTC 62931 adjuvant NEGATIVE (verified, with the Sarcul…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: WHO 2020 soft tissue classification (~70 subtypes - textbook-grade, cited to the book); FNCLCC grade as the dominant prognostic axis and AJCC's known limits (textbook-grade); EXPERT PATHOLOGY REVIEW as the router's guardian (verified discordance receipts)
meta.response: RECIST with histology-specific caveats taught (trabectedin's verified tissue-density-before-shrinkage pearl in myxoid liposarcoma; desmoids judged on symptoms and growth arrest); the 62012 verbatim discipline - combination chemotherapy 'unless the goal is tumour shrinkage' - response is not survival

Newly diagnosed.name: Limb-sparing surgery + RT (localized extremity/trunk - the standard with its trades)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the extremity standard (verified principle + verified trade + verified adjuvant nulls)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: surgery + RT's field ledger (wound now or fibrosis later - the traded halves)
Newly diagnosed.patient: For arm, leg, and trunk sarcomas: surgery that saves the limb, plus radiation - equal to amputation and proven so decades ago; chemotherapy afterward is a selective, honest conversation, not a default.

Newly diagnosed.name: Compartment resection (retroperitoneal - the exception with its retired RT)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the retroperitoneal standard (surgery; RT retired by verified STRASS)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: major multi-visceral surgery - the compartment philosophy's price
Newly diagnosed.patient: For deep abdominal sarcomas: one carefully planned operation at an experienced center is the treatment - adding radiation first was properly tested and did not help, so the honest open question is chemotherapy, currently being answered in a trial enrolling in the US.

Newly diagnosed.name: Doxorubicin first line (advanced common high-grade - the survivor)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the anthracycline ledger (cardiac ceiling included); ifosfamide's added cost bought only where shrinkage pays
Newly diagnosed.patient: For spread high-grade sarcoma: the fifty-year-old standard remains first because every challenger has lost to it - adding a second drug shrinks tumors more without extending life, so it is saved for when shrinkage itself matters.
drugs: Doxorubicin (+/- ifosfamide per the shrinkage-goal discipline)

Newly diagnosed.name: Chemotherapy then the cell-therapy chapter (advanced synovial/MRCLS)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: chemo then cell therapy (approval verified secondhand; receipts verified)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: verified single-arm receipt + full approval; figure flagged
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: lymphodepletion + CRS/neurotoxicity ledgers for the cell therapy - transplant-adjacent craft
Newly diagnosed.patient: Synovial sarcoma now has an engineered-T-cell therapy with full FDA approval - eligibility depends on inherited immune type (HLA) and a tumor protein, so those tests happen at the start, not when other options run out.
drugs: Ifosfamide-based chemotherapy; afamitresgene autoleucel (Tecelra) where HLA/MAGE-A4-eligible

Newly diagnosed.name: The histology-directed shelf (advanced boutique subtypes - each its own receipt)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: drug-by-drug receipts at their verified grades
Newly diagnosed.evidence: per-subtype (verified where marked); the composite figure flagged HARD
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: subtype-drug-specific (the pexidartinib REMS; the nirogacestat ovarian counseling; the atezolizumab ledger)
Newly diagnosed.patient: The rare sarcoma subtypes each have their own playbook now - an immunotherapy for one, a leukemia pill for another, a targeted pill for desmoid tumors - matched to the exact diagnosis.
drugs: Atezolizumab (ASPS) · paclitaxel (angiosarcoma) · trabectedin (myxoid LPS) · imatinib (DFSP) · nirogacestat (desmoid) · vimseltinib/pexidartinib (TGCT)

refs.label: THE DISCORDANCE RECEIPTS (the briefing's range corrected UPWARD): 25% major discrepancy, 45% of majors benign-called-sarcoma (PMID 11601130, pubmed-url-match); SECSG series - 66% total agreement, 27% wrong subtype (3772418, matched); second-opinion series 17918224 (matched); the prospective Rhone-Alpes program (>40% modified; 19% complete discordance) surfaced as PMC-ONLY - PMID FLAGGED. Expert review IS treatment | PMID 11601130 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

~70 WHO 2020 subtypes; FNCLCC grade the dominant prognostic axis; AJCC's known limits - ALL TEXTBOOK-GRADE, cited to the WHO Classification (no PMIDs fabricated); epi ~13,000 US cases/yr memory-grade (ACS-sourced)

THE LIMB-SPARING PRINCIPLE: Rosenberg NCI RCT (Ann Surg 1982 - PMID 7114936, pubmed-url-match): 43 patients randomized 1975-81 - taught as PRINCIPLE-SETTER, never effect size (the size honesty); THE 1992 DECOY documented (1543400 - Williard, reads like the landmark). O'Sullivan pre-vs-postop RT (Lancet 2002 - 12103287, matched): preop -> more wound complications (verified direction); THE LATE-FIBROSIS HALF lives in the Davis 2005 follow-up - PMID FLAGGED (journal/DOI-cited). The 'whoops'-excision logic convention-grade | PMID 7114936 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26
refs.src: Ann Surg / Lancet (matched; decoy + flag documented)

refs.label: ADJUVANT HONESTY verified end-to-end: SMAC meta-analysis (Lancet 1997 - PMID 9400508, pubmed-url-match: 1,568 pts, 14 trials - RFS/local/distant benefit, OS TREND only; THE COCHRANE TWIN documented: 10796873 near-identically titled); EORTC 62931 NEGATIVE (22954508, matched: no RFS or OS benefit) with the Sarculator reanalysis nuance (30690293, matched: benefit confined to low-predicted-OS); ISG-STS 1001 (28499583, matched - design verified; THE REVERSAL - standard epirubicin+ifosfamide BEAT histology-tailored - carried at MEMORY grade pending the final-paper receipt; risk-stratification analysis 34643947 matched) | PMID 9400508 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

SU2C-SARC032 (secondhand - Lancet 2024, POSITIVE): neoadjuvant pembrolizumab + preoperative RT in stage III extremity UPS/dedifferentiated-pleomorphic LPS - DFS HR 0.61 (90% CI 0.39-0.96); 2-yr DFS 67% vs 52%; tolerable. Phase-2 evidence entering the localized conversation; guideline uptake to confirm; the perioperative-IO turn

STRASS/EORTC-62092 (Lancet Oncol 2020 - PMID 32941794, pubmed-url-match): preoperative RT in retroperitoneal sarcoma - NO abdominal-RFS difference; 'preoperative radiotherapy should not be considered standard of care' (VERBATIM, verified snippet); THE LIPOSARCOMA SIGNAL held exactly at its grade: STREXIT pooled EXPLORATORY analysis (35833413, matched) - hypothesis-only, said. THE REPRINT DECOY documented (a PMC variant title circulates - cite only 32941794) | PMID 32941794 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

EORTC 62012 (Lancet Oncol 2014 - PMID 24618336, pubmed-url-match - THE MIS-CITED-PMID TRAP: the natural-language search returns only secondary analyses; exact-title search required - the sweep's highest-value catch): 455 pts - dox+ifosfamide improves ORR/PFS, NOT OS, more toxicity; 'do not support intensified AI unless the goal is tumour shrinkage' (VERBATIM). Doxorubicin the surviving 1L standard | PMID 24618336 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE OLARATUMAB REVERSAL ARC (property-enforced - never carded): accelerated approval 2016 (memory-grade date, FDA-sourced) -> ANNOUNCE NEGATIVE (JAMA 2020 - PMID 32259228, pubmed-url-match: no OS difference; THE NUANCE kept - topline 2019, publication 2020) -> withdrawal 2019-20 (memory-grade, FDA-sourced). The accelerated-approval lifecycle's first sarcoma lesson; the comparison paper matched (32235164). Brigimadlin's 1L failure (Brightline-1, secondhand - CCR 2026) the sequel | PMID 32259228 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE CELL-THERAPY CHAPTER: SPEARHEAD-1 (Lancet 2024 - PMID 38554725, pubmed-url-match): ORR 43.2% (95% CI 28.4-59.0), CR 4.5%, mDoR 6.0 mo, f/u 21.9 mo - WITH THE NUANCE KEPT (MRCLS in the trial; SYNOVIAL-only label); FDA Approval Summary matched (40423661). REGULATORY ARC verified secondhand multi-source: accelerated 2024-08-01 -> FULL approval 2026-06-22, EXPANDED to age >=12 - the first engineered-T-cell FULL approval in a solid tumor; the PORTFOLIO SOLD to US WorldMeds (~2025-08; access rerouted - said). Lete-cel (NY-ESO-1; MRCLS BTD): rolling BLA, approval NOT granted as of this sweep - date-stamped. SPEARHEAD-3 basket door (sponsor-of-record in transition, flagged) | PMID 38554725 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

ASPS - THE IO EXCEPTION: atezolizumab (Chen, NEJM 2023 - PMID 37672694, pubmed-url-match: sustained responses in ~one third; NCT03141684); the first-systemic-approval paper matched (37466080); approval 2022-12-09 incl. peds >=2 (memory-grade date, FDA-sourced); AXIOM (atezolizumab+selinexor, NCT05333458) the recruiting follow-on. The contrast receipts: A091401 nivo+/-ipi (29370992, matched; expansion 39343511) modest - IO stays trial-routed outside ASPS (SARC028's LMS null cross-referenced) | PMID 37672694 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

ANGIOSARCOMA: weekly paclitaxel (ANGIOTAX, JCO 2008 - PMID 18809609, pubmed-url-match: PFS 74%@2mo/45%@4mo; mTTP 4 mo; mOS 8 mo) + EORTC retrospective (18771914, matched); A091902's SPLIT evidence (secondhand): taxane-naive paclitaxel+/-nivolumab NO overall PFS benefit (scalp/face signal only); taxane-pretreated cabozantinib+nivolumab ORR 59% single-arm - evidence, not doors; the pembro+lenvatinib cutaneous-angio phase 2 (NCT06673628) and the propranolol+pembro all-STS phase 1b/2 (NCT05961761) the flagged doors | PMID 18809609 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE 2026 REWRITE - TAZEMETOSTAT WITHDRAWN WORLDWIDE (the sweep's loudest currency event; property-enforced - never carded): Ipsen voluntary withdrawal 2026-03-09, ALL indications ALL markets; SYMPHONY-1 IDMC found secondary hematologic malignancies 5.7% vs 0 control; FDA safety alert; ALL trials + expanded access STOPPED (all secondhand, multi-source: FDA/Ipsen/trade press). EPITHELIOID SARCOMA HAS NO APPROVED DRUG as of this sweep - chemotherapy + generic STS trials the honest pathway; 'approved 2020' nodes are wrong-and-dangerous. The accelerated-approval lifecycle's hardest lesson: approvals can be SUBTRACTED

THE LATER LINES, scopes enforced: pazopanib PALETTE (cross-referenced VERIFIED - non-adipocytic); trabectedin (cross-referenced VERIFIED - L-sarcomas on-label) + the myxoid-LPS sensitivity receipt (Grosso, Lancet Oncol 2007 - PMID 17586092, pubmed-url-match; the density-before-shrinkage imaging pearl); eribulin (cross-referenced VERIFIED - LIPOSARCOMA-only label; carded here FOR liposarcoma with the LMS-null traveling); regorafenib REGOSARC (27751846, matched: LMS PFS 3.7 vs 1.8; synovial 5.6 vs 1.0); gem/doce convention-grade | PMID 27751846 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

DFSP: imatinib pooled EORTC+SWOG (Rutkowski, JCO 2010 - PMID 20194851, pubmed-url-match: 400-800mg, 'high activity'); surgery/Mohs the local standard (convention); THE EMPTY BUCKET said: NO open US interventional DFSP trial found - imatinib-resistance salvage 'never systematically investigated' (2025 review, secondhand); ultra-rare baskets the only routing | PMID 20194851 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

DESMOID (not-quite-sarcoma nuance said): SURVEILLANCE-FIRST (convention-grade), then NIROGACESTAT (DeFi, NEJM 2023 - PMID 36884323, pubmed-url-match; FDA 2023-11 the first desmoid approval - memory-grade date + pathway paper 39944188 matched); THE OVARIAN-TOXICITY counseling receipt matched (38703010 - mostly transient); the second GSI (varegacestat/AL102) positive topline 2025-12 (secondhand, unverified further); tegavivint the AYA door (NCT uncaptured - flagged) | PMID 36884323 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

TGCT - SOLVED TWICE (both primaries honestly FLAGGED): pexidartinib ENLIVEN primary NOT url-matched (cite DOI 10.1016/S0140-6736(19)30764-0; 39% wk-25 response vs 0 - search-prose grade; THE DECOY documented: 32755241 trial-name-in-title profile paper) with the REMS hepatotoxicity receipt MATCHED (40438996 - the black-box teaching point); vimseltinib MOTION primary FLAGGED (38843859 title-mismatch - probable Comment); Romvimza FULL approval 2025-02-14 (secondhand: ORR 40% vs 0); pimicotinib MANEUVER phase 3 MATCHED (41796601) - the third agent as currency | PMID 40438996 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

MPNST - the near-graveyard: SARC031 (selumetinib+sirolimus) NEGATIVE (Clin Cancer Res 2026 - secondhand: clinical benefit 1/7, 1/14; 'did not meet parameters'); SPEARHEAD-3 the rare open door; SELUMETINIB'S SCOPE said exactly (pediatric plexiform neurofibroma - SPRINT; NOT MPNST; PMID unverified, none printed); chemotherapy convention-grade

THE SHELF + EMPTY BUCKETS: AXIOM (NCT05333458, recruiting 2026-06); SPEARHEAD-3 (NCT05642455, recruiting; sponsor-of-record in transition); SARC042 = FUNDRAISING not a trial (the pipeline-vs-door distinction); tegavivint NCT uncaptured; unverified-status listings (NCT05182164/NCT06113809/NCT04332874/NCT05679921); EMPTY: DFSP, post-withdrawal epithelioid, MPNST-beyond-SPEARHEAD-3, angio-propranolol-named, desmoid-GSI-window; EX-US never US doors: China ASPS trials (NCT07548177/NCT06384248/NCT03623581), AngioCheck (EU), LMS-04 lineage (French), BIOVAS

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.

Doxorubicin +/- pembrolizumab phase 3 (NCT06422806): 1L metastatic UPS/DDLPS, PFS primary, separate histology questions - RECRUITING (MSK 25-239/UCSF/Jefferson secondhand-confirmed; lead group unverified) - web-verified 2026-08-20, registry re-check due. THE live 1L randomized door after brigimadlin failed

STRASS2 (NCT04031677) / ECOG-ACRIN EA7211: phase 3 - neoadjuvant chemotherapy + surgery vs surgery alone, high-risk retroperitoneal DDLPS/LMS, DFS primary - RECRUITING (2026-05 source); EORTC-LED with VERIFIED US enrollment (Dana-Farber 23-614/NYU/Fred Hutch secondhand) - the ex-US-led/US-enrolling nuance stated exactly - web-verified 2026-08-20, registry re-check due

Sperm, oocyte, and embryo cryopreservation are standard practice; GnRHa is not a substitute for proven methods (may be offered in young women with breast cancer when proven methods are not feasible).

CARDIAC DYSFUNCTION PREVENTION/MONITORING: Armenian et al., ASCO Clinical Practice Guideline (J Clin Oncol 2017;35:893-911 - PMID 27918725, pubmed-eutils abstract read 2026-08-27): initiate the cardiac-dysfunction discussion BEFORE beginning therapy where risk is sufficiently high; higher-risk populations may benefit from prevention and screening strategies during cancer-directed therapy; keep clinical suspicion high and the evaluation threshold low after potentially cardiotoxic therapy. Companion European framework: 2022 ESC cardio-oncology guidelines (PMID 36017568, esummary-verified).
